notes: Printed: 'Whenever another creature you control enters, this creature deals damage equal to that creature's power to any target.' Bone Pit Brute (4/5) enters, and its own trigger ('target creature gets +4/+0 until end of turn') triggers with Terror's. Their controller orders them (CR 603.3b): Brute's resolves first (the word 'b'), so Terror's goes on the stack first, aimed at seat 1, and the Brute's above it, aimed at itself. Terror's damage is the Brute's power as it resolves (CR 608.2h): 8, so seat 1 goes 20 -> 12. terror_of_the_peaks_4 is the other order.
